name: Rumi Wrap Midi Dress
description: A midi wrap dress with a tie waist and three-quarter sleeves. The cotton-linen blend breathes well in hot weather, and the wrap front lets the wearer adjust the fit. Pairs with flats for the office or sandals at the weekend.

name: Shefali Embroidered Maxi
description: A floor-length georgette maxi with gold thread embroidery on the yoke and cuffs. The full cotton lining keeps it comfortable through long evenings. Made for wedding receptions and festive dinners.

name: Bela Tiered Sundress
description: A sleeveless tiered sundress in light cotton voile with adjustable straps and side pockets. Cool and easy for daytime outings and beach trips.

name: Nira Shirt Dress
description: A knee-length shirt dress with a full button front, a removable belt and roll-up sleeves. Crisp cotton poplin keeps its shape through a full workday.

name: Tara Satin Slip Dress
description: A bias-cut midi slip dress with a cowl neckline and thin adjustable straps. Wear it alone for evening events or layer it under a blazer. Gentle hand wash or dry clean only.

name: Mira A-Line Kurti Dress
description: A knee-length A-line dress with a mandarin collar and a block-printed border at the hem. Soft rayon drapes well and works alone or over leggings and palazzos.

name: Ayra Block Print Kurti
description: A straight-cut hip-length kurti in hand block-printed cotton with side slits and three-quarter sleeves. Pairs well with the Lina Wide-Leg Palazzo.

name: Lina Wide-Leg Palazzo
description: Flowy wide-leg palazzo pants with an elastic waist and side pockets. A neutral base that matches most of the store's tops and kurtis.

name: Sana Ruffle Blouse
description: A lined chiffon blouse with a ruffled neckline and button cuffs. Tucks neatly into trousers for work and dresses up with a satin skirt for parties.

name: Kaya Linen Co-ord Set
description: A boxy short-sleeve linen shirt with matching drawstring trousers, sold together as a set. Breathable and relaxed for travel and warm days.
